entities.name: Baha'i Faith
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A world religion founded by Baha'u'llah (1817-1892) in Persia, teaching the essential unity of all religions and the oneness of humanity. Emerging from the Babi movement in 1863, the Baha'i Faith emphasizes universal education, gender equality, elimination of prejudice, and world governance, growing to 5+ million adherents in virtually every country.
